title: Backtest Z-Score M3
desc: Uji strategi Z-Score di XAUUSD M3 (1 Okt – 24 Nov 2026): entry saat z pertama menyentuh ±2, SL 1,5σ beku, TP RR 1:2 — hasil terbaik +34,27R setelah spread dari 619 trade berurutan.
prompt: Backtest Z-Score M3 XAUUSD pakai Python: entry z pertama ≤ −2 / ≥ +2, SL = 1,5σ dibekukan, bandingkan RR 1:1, 1:1,5, dan 1:2 setelah spread, tampilkan per bulan dan per minggu.
code:
# Z-Score: entry pertama menyentuh ±2, SL 1.5σ beku
import pandas as pd

df['ma']  = df['close'].rolling(20).mean()
df['std'] = df['close'].rolling(20).std()
df['z']   = (df['close'] - df['ma']) / df['std']

sinyal = df[(df['z'] <= -2) | (df['z'] >= 2)]
# RR 1:2 → win 37,5% · net +34,27R (n=619, setelah spread)
# RR 1:1 → win 51,2% tapi NET MINUS — jangan dipakai live
